about: Wavehunters has run surf schools on the north Cornwall coast since 2002, with beachside bases at Polzeath and Watergate Bay. It also runs boat trips from Padstow, Rock and Port Isaac. Its surf schools hire out wetsuits and boards alongside lessons, a grom club and beach fitness sessions.
where: Beachside surf schools at Polzeath and Watergate Bay
